name: disposition
description: The researcher's own disposition surface for their Task Agent: look at what is queued, running or waiting for an answer, answer it, cancel it, and record an append-only accept/reject on a finished execution.
notes: This is the local gateway/mcp role of the kit the researcher deployed; it is not the central gateway. It reads and writes the local execution store only.
There is deliberately no submit_owner_command and no tool that creates an execution. Handoffs arrive over the queue; a tool that could start one would be a back door around the handoff contract.

review_execution records a decision on a finished execution. It is not a candidate review and carries no formalize capability: the draft a worker writes still has to go through the draft box and the domain MCP.

tools.name: health
tools.description: Report whether the disposition surface and its execution store are usable.
allowed: checking the local services before a debugging session

tools.name: query_execution
tools.description: Read one execution: status, draft id, error code and failed agent.
allowed: finding out why a handoff did not produce a draft

tools.name: list_pending
tools.description: List executions that still need a human: queued, running or waiting for an answer.

tools.name: cancel_execution
tools.description: Cancel a queued, running or waiting execution. A finished execution keeps its status.
allowed: stopping a handoff that was dispatched with the wrong target

tools.name: answer_question
tools.description: Answer a pending question and put its execution back in the queue.
allowed: unblocking a worker that asked the researcher something

tools.name: review_execution
tools.description: Record an append-only review decision (accepted or rejected) on a finished execution.
allowed: recording that the researcher read the worker's own report
